# `kernel/time/ExpirationManager.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/time/ExpirationManager.js`

ExpirationManager.js — TTL tracking for short-lived AI artifacts (capabilities, elicitations, pending approvals). Sweep-based (no timers per item): callers invoke sweep() periodically or before authorization checks; expired items run their onExpire callback exactly once and are removed.

## Classes

### `class ExpirationManager`

ExpirationManager.js — TTL tracking for short-lived AI artifacts (capabilities, elicitations, pending approvals). Sweep-based (no timers per item): callers invoke sweep() periodically or before authorization checks; expired items run their onExpire callback exactly once and are removed.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `track` | `track(id, ttlMs, onExpire = null)` | Track an item for `ttlMs`. Re-tracking an id replaces its TTL. |
| `isExpired` | `isExpired(id)` | True if the id is tracked and past its expiry (sweep may not have run yet). |
| `isActive` | `isActive(id)` | True if the id is tracked and still valid. |
| `cancel` | `cancel(id)` | Stop tracking without firing onExpire. |
| `sweep` | `sweep()` | Remove all expired items, invoking each onExpire once. @returns {string[]} expired ids |
| `size` | `get size()` |  |

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```
